newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA'S STOYANOV LEADS FIRST ROUND POLL - OFFICIAL.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA'S STOYANOV LEADS FIRST ROUND POLL - OFFICIAL.

text.p: Bulgarian opposition candidate Petar Stoyanov won 43.92 percent of the votes in weekend presidential elections and a second round will be held on Sunday, the electoral commission said on Tuesday.
Final results given by a commission spokesman speaking on state radio showed Culture Minister Ivan Marazov, candidate of the governing Socialists, came second with 26.92 percent.
